name: OpenAI
description: AI research and product company behind the GPT model family, ChatGPT and the OpenAI API.

name: Anthropic
description: AI safety and research company that builds the Claude model family, offered through the Claude apps, the Claude API and major cloud platforms.

name: Google DeepMind
description: Google's AI research lab. It develops the Gemini model family, offered through the Gemini API, Google AI Studio and Google Cloud.

name: Meta
description: Meta Superintelligence Labs builds the Muse model family: Muse Spark is served through the Meta AI app and the Meta Model API, and Muse Glimmer is released as open weights.

name: xAI (SpaceXAI)
description: Creator of the Grok models, available through the Grok apps, Grok Build and the xAI API. Its own pages now brand the company SpaceXAI.

name: DeepSeek
description: AI lab that publishes the DeepSeek model family as open weights under the MIT licence and serves it through the DeepSeek API.

name: Mistral AI
description: AI company that releases the Mistral model family, many of them as open weights, and serves them through the Mistral API.

name: Microsoft
description: Microsoft AI builds the in-house MAI model family, offered through Microsoft Foundry and Microsoft products.

name: NVIDIA
description: NVIDIA publishes the Nemotron family of open models, released with open checkpoints and technical reports.

name: Alibaba (Qwen)
description: Alibaba's Qwen team builds the Qwen model family, served through Alibaba Cloud Model Studio and QwenCloud, with open-weight releases on Hugging Face.

name: Cohere
description: Enterprise AI company that builds the Command family of language models, plus embedding, rerank and speech models, with a focus on private and sovereign deployment.

name: Amazon
description: Amazon builds the Nova family of foundation models, offered through Amazon Bedrock.
